summary: Ship only Wine Tahoma and refuse startup without it
author: pm
body:
Removed arial, segoeui, MS tahoma and default.ttf from `staged/client/fonts/`; ship `wine_tahoma.ttf` (LGPL 2.1, licence beside it); no system-font lookup (`LoadFontByName` removed); startup refused with "Unable to load default font" when it is missing.

**Done when:** deployed fonts folder holds only Wine Tahoma; reviewed, built Debug 0 errors.

Source: user request 2026-11-23, commit 9cfd510.
